caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical stoneware jar with two small handles on either side near the top. The jar is rendered in shades of gray and beige, indicating its ceramic material. The jar features a decorative design near the top front, consisting of stylized blue floral motifs with dotted accents, and is accompanied by text that reads "J. DONNELL / UTICA, N.Y. ROKA" and "1 1/2". The open mouth of the jar has a thick, rounded lip, and the interior is shaded to give a sense of depth. The composition is centered on the plain paper background, with a faint rectangular border framing the drawing. The artist's signature appears in the bottom left corner outside the rectangular border.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
